WITH driver_counts AS (
  SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM qualifying
  GROUP BY driverId
),
avg_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(cnt) as avg_cnt
  FROM driver_counts
)
SELECT 
  driver_counts.driverId,
  driver_counts.cnt as count,
  CAST(driver_counts.cnt AS REAL) / avg_count.avg_cnt as ratio
FROM driver_counts
CROSS JOIN avg_count
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
